source_clauses.section: Highlights and Index Family - Equal Weight Indices
source_clauses.extraction: Composition matches the underlying index and each company is equally weighted at the rebalance reference date.

source_clauses.section: Appendix B - S&P Equal Weight U.S. Indices
source_clauses.extraction: The S&P 500 Equal Weight Index uses the S&P 500 as its underlying index; underlying constituent changes pass through.

source_clauses.section: Appendix C - Constituent Weighting Reference Date
source_clauses.extraction: Quarterly equal weighting uses closing prices from the second Friday of the quarter-ending month; methodology change table records the subsequent effective convention.

agent_sizing.required_input: source-backed aggregate USD assets tracking the S&P 500 Equal Weight Index

scope.universe: constituents published for the S&P 500 Equal Weight Index

trigger.reference_date: second Friday of March, June, September and December

execution.effective: after close of the Friday following the reference date

required: official S&P constituent and rebalance files

blocking_reason: No primary, point-in-time aggregate agent-pool series or licensed event constituent file is present; the rule must suppress rather than infer either input.

source_document.title: Russell US Equity Indexes Construction and Methodology

source_clauses.extraction: Reconstitution occurs on the fourth Friday in June and second Friday in December.
Additional share classes require minimum size, liquidity and at least 5% free float.
Russell 2000 membership comprises companies ranked 1001 through 3000 by descending total market capitalization.
Existing members near capitalization breakpoints are subject to the published cumulative bands.
Weights use available, float-adjusted market capitalization: primary closing price times available shares.
June and December rank, preliminary release, query, lockdown and implementation stages are explicitly scheduled; preliminary additions, deletions, shares and float are published.

agent_sizing.required_input: source-backed aggregate USD assets tracking Russell 2000 mandates
agent_sizing.excluded_proxy: The methodology's family-wide benchmarked-assets estimate is not Russell 2000-specific.

scope.universe: official Russell 2000 additions, deletions and float-adjusted constituents

blocking_reason: Official event files and a Russell-2000-specific point-in-time agent pool are absent locally; no membership, weight or flow is inferred from rank alone.

source_clauses.extraction: The daily target is three times the daily Nasdaq-100 return and does not apply to longer periods.
The fund uses securities and derivatives, including swaps and futures, to obtain its daily target.
The portfolio is rebalanced each day; exposure rises after an index rise and falls after an index decline, absent unit flows.

agent_sizing.required_input: prior-day assets under management adjusted for creations and redemptions

scope.single_equity_projection: forbidden without a documented dealer or constituent transmission model

execution.window: toward daily rebalance around NAV close

direction.property: beta * (beta - 1) is positive for beta in {2,3,-1,-2,-3}

magnitude.derivation_status: algebraically derived, not represented as prospectus text

cost_floor.reason: execution_timing output; fees and financing are not fitted into the daily rebalance identity
